name: PALE FRAIL ―Haishiro no Bourei―
source:
Challenge the mystery that happens in the hospital! Mystery horror novel
People are dying one after another around the inpatient's flame summer <Honoka>.
Is it natural death or artificial? Gradually the eyes of suspicion are turned to the girl.
When he doesn't want to see people die anymore, he decides to fight the mystery ...

[From [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/24940]Freem![/url]]
translation:
挑战发生在医院中的谜团！一部悬疑恐怖视觉小说。

住院少女炎夏的身边，不断有人接连死亡。

是自然死亡，还是人为所致？怀疑的目光渐渐转向了少女。

不愿再目睹有人死去，炎夏决心独自面对这个谜团…

[摘自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/24940]Freem![/url]]
